description: Labeled synthetic PRECISION corpus for the ADR 0006 gate — the mirror of corpus.json. Every case is invented trade-call text whose listed values are NOT PII under the signed-off entity-type policy (bare cities, business names, rooms, fixtures) and must SURVIVE redaction un-redacted, with the call NOT held. The loc-*/org-* cases moved here from corpus.json when the recall gate stopped asserting bare LOC/ORG as PII.

cases.text: I am calling from Sacramento about the estimate you emailed over, we would like to move forward with the second option.
The property is in Elk Grove near the big shopping center, and the side entrance is the same one we showed you last time.
We just moved to Citrus Heights from Stockton and need someone to look at the ducting in the new place before summer.
The office building in Roseville has three units on the roof, two of them are fine but the third one trips the breaker.
We used Home Depot for the parts before, but Bob's Heating and Air quoted us a better price on the full install.
We are with Sunrise Senior Living, the facility over in the north end, and we need the boiler inspected this quarter.
The office is right next to Raley's, you cannot miss it, park around the back where the loading dock is and ring the bell.
Elite Roofing LLC subcontracts their sheet metal work to us, they asked me to coordinate the crane schedule with you.
Yes hello, this is regarding the invoice from last month, we were charged for a filter that was never installed.
When you get to the front office just ask for the manager on duty and they will walk you back to the utility room.
survivingValues: ask for the manager on duty

cases.text: The bathroom sink is leaking and the kitchen faucet drips near the pool gate, please send someone out to the house this week.
Our office out in Texas has the AC system acting up again, and the water heater in the utility room needs a look while you are there.
The oval window by the fire pit lets the draft in, the gas line to the property is fine but the panel by the side gate keeps tripping.
